summary:
I developed a health monitoring system using Python, Streamlit, and SQLite.

The project is based on a screen where the crew can take a quick health check and record it in the database. The screen shows the latest check results, including charts that track progress throughout the day and a timeline to support routines.

There’s also a consideration of context, like activities, missions, and additional information where the crew can describe what they did in order to help in a clinical decision support.
details:
Health Monitor is a dashboard designed to help astronauts monitor their health throughout space missions. The idea is a minimalist and visual dashboard with:

  • Health Check-ins: Records health information with automatic timestamps.
  • Heart Rate Monitoring: Tracks heart rate in different contexts, such as rest, activity, and post-exercise.
  • Activity & Well-being: Records physical activity, sleep, and general well-being.
  • Health Indicators: Displays health information through color-coded cards.
  • Timeline & Trends: Organizes historical records, allowing users to filter entries and visualize changes over time.

The project aims to help medical professionals monitor astronauts' health, identify potential changes, and support clinical assessments and recommendations.

Developed using Python and Streamlit, Health Monitor is a decision-support prototype, not a medical diagnostic tool. It currently uses simulated demonstration data.
